ios.desc:
Tinnilog is your comprehensive tinnitus tracking app designed to detect triggers, monitor treatment progress, and enhance personal well-being.

Start by logging daily diary-like entries, allowing Tinnilog to paint a detailed picture of your tinnitus journey.

Our robust analytics will help identify ways to minimize tinnitus intensity, empowering you with data-driven insights.

With just the tap of a button, you can see if your tinnitus has improved or intensified.

Tinnilog serves as an invaluable tool, not just for personalized measures, but also to assess the efficacy of treatments suggested by your otologist or audiologist.


• • • Features • • •

CREATE TRACKING ENTRIES
in a matter of seconds, even from Apple Watch.

TINNITUS TRIGGERS
automatically identified and classified as softening or intensifying.

TINNITUS CALENDAR
daily, monthly, and yearly views.

TINNITUS TREND ANALYSIS
discover patterns and insights.

TINNITUS AND SLEEP ANALYSIS
find out how your sleep influences your tinnitus.

REMINDERS
smart, customizable and randomizable if desired.

COLOR THEMES
create your own, or choose any of 14 themes, fully customizable.

AUTOMATIC iCLOUD BACKUP
hassle-free and reliable, safeguarding against data loss.

PDF EXPORT
convert your tracking data into a printer-friendly PDF.

CSV EXPORT
export your tracking data into a CSV for your own app-external analysis.

CSV IMPORT
import external historical tinnitus tracking data into Tinnilog with the CSV Import wizard. 

FACE ID/TOUCH ID
ensuring access is reserved only for you.

EVENTS-SYSTEM
detail your day and let Tinnilog analyze influencing factors.

WIDGETS
elegant, valuable and convenient.

APPLE WATCH APP
fully integrated, allowing entry creation and tinnitus trend monitoring from your wrist.

HIGHEST USER PRIVACY
your data stays private, securely stored on your iPhone only.


• • • Contact • • •

Feedback, questions, suggestions? - You are more than welcome!
